title: Gander Welcomed Americans in 2001. Now, U.S.-Canada Tensions Hit Home.
summary: The Newfoundland town welcomed thousands of frightened airline passengers on Sept. 11, but 25 years later, mixed emotions run through anniversary plans amid an escalating trade war.
